title: oauth-helper
summary: --- name: oauth-helper description: | Automate OAuth login flows with user confirmation via Telegram. Supports 7 providers: Google, Apple, Microsoft, GitHub, Discord, WeChat, QQ. Features: - Auto-detect available OAuth options on login pages - Ask user to choose via Telegram when multiple options exist - Confirm before authorizing - Handle account selection and consent pages automatically
